summary: Executed backend regression suite and targeted frontend validation for the four-page reference contract. Backend passed after updating stale Theatre/Rakh contract expectations. Frontend public layout checks mostly passed (load/order/geometry/overflow), but Live Editor save/reopen automation for Theatre/Rakh text+style persistence remained inconclusive.

If manual issue reproduces, investigate Live Editor panel state/reopen lifecycle and textarea/style control binding after reload.

Theatre local asset hash check depended on superseded local files; converted to conditional skip when no applicable local rehearsal reference asset matches current approved image.
